name: @monopsony/board-assets
description: Bundled glTF token models, the cosmetic manifest schema, and the scripts that check, optimise and upload assets.

scripts.typecheck: node --check scripts/glb.mjs && node --check scripts/make-models.mjs && node --check scripts/check-glb.mjs && node --check scripts/upload.mjs
scripts.test: node scripts/make-models.mjs && node scripts/check-glb.mjs models/tophat.glb && node scripts/check-glb.mjs models/rocket.glb && node scripts/check-glb.mjs models/crown.glb && node scripts/check-glb.mjs models/trophy.glb && node scripts/check-glb.mjs models/car.glb && node scripts/check-glb.mjs models/king.glb
